mkdir -p "$TMP"
call() {

  else
    code=$(curl -sS -o "$TMP/$name.body" -D "$TMP/$name.head" -w '%{http_code}' -X "$method" "$url")
  fi
  echo "$code"
}
call probe GET "$PL"; ls "$TMP"
